{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')].copy()

# Compute raw conversion rates by channel (unadjusted)
conv_rate_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conv_rate_paid_search = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
raw_difference = conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search

# Print raw difference
print(f"Raw conversion rate (email): {conv_rate_email:.4f}")
print(f"Raw conversion rate (paid_search): {conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}")
print(f"Raw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_difference:.4f}")"}
